explanation: The isolated natural-interval run compiled and assembled the source objects, but the final Aztec link returned guest status 10. Its t000-ln.log is empty and no executable was produced. The verifier receipt is BLOCKED/COMPILE_ERROR; unit_diag therefore returns UNSUPPORTED with CACHED_COMPILER_OUTPUT_NOT_COMPILED, so no per-member predictions can be measured. The 44-byte 0x59E6..0x5A12 span remains UNKNOWN_NOT_ASSIGNED. A linker diagnostic or object-level unresolved-symbol report is needed to identify a safe next source change.

proposed_blocker.text: The isolated Aztec 3.6a natural-interval build for ov11_F_487E and seven --member sources compiled and assembled all source objects, then the final link returned status 10. The retained t000-ln.log is empty, no linked executable exists, and unit_diag reports CACHED_COMPILER_OUTPUT_NOT_COMPILED. Provide linker stdout/stderr or an unresolved-symbol report before attributing the failure to a particular source member; the original 0x59E6..0x5A12 gap stays unclaimed.
